title: Guesswork costs water and yield
talking_points: Most farms schedule irrigation on a calendar, not on what the soil actually needs.
That means some blocks get watered too early and others too late.
Both directions cost money: wasted water on one side, stressed plants on the other.

content.headline: Calendar-based watering guesses in both directions
bullets: Underwatering shows up as yield loss weeks later
Neither mistake is visible until it's too late to fix

narrator_guidance: Name the problem plainly. Do not use numbers or statistics that are not on the slide.
